text: Vodafone Spain (Vodafone España, Lowi's parent company) is 100% owned by Zegona Communications, an investor listed on the London Stock Exchange.

source.name: Zegona Communications, 'About us' / 'Investment in Vodafone Spain'
source.quote: Zegona is the 100% owner of Vodafone Spain, a telecom operator providing mobile and fixed line services to both consumers and business customers in Spain.
